title: artificial-organism model
description: The portable AO model extracted from kotoba-lang/tamaki: the AgentRun contract and its state machine, finite organism lineage with governed succession, and human-in-the-loop capability policy. Model only — no CLI, no runner, no storage.

not-owned-here.capability-contract: kotoba-lang/kotoba-core-contracts already owns vocabulary, ABI, effect classes and validation; kotoba.tamaki.capability is only an adapter over it and was deliberately NOT copied.
not-owned-here.execution: runner pool, node dispatch, reconcile plan, murakumo and kotoba-code integration stay in tamaki.
